description: Write a pending change request instead of changing the site: title, summary, rationale, 1–20 concrete changes and optional rule ids. The site owner approves or rejects it in the console; rejection notes come back through list_proposals. Use this when the fix is a judgment call or touches the user's pages — it does not modify the site, write an audit run or consume an audit run. Requires the audits:write scope and a key owned by an account. Repeating an identical proposal while one is pending returns the existing row with deduplicated=true.

rationale.description: The evidence chain: findings, rules, pages and expected effect

ruleIds.description: Optional rule ids this proposal addresses

summary.description: One-paragraph statement of what should change and why it matters

targetUrl.description: Optional page URL; must be http(s) and on the site's domain

name: propose_fix
title: Propose a fix for human review
